references.text: Moses describes how God will bless the land of Israel with fertility if they follow His commandments, which reflects the idea of bearing fruit in good soil.
Isaiah compares God's word to rain that brings growth, similar to the image of a seed falling into good soil and bearing fruit.
Hosea calls for righteousness and promises that the Lord will come with His blessing, much like the image of a seed yielding a plentiful harvest.
Paul speaks about how what one sows, one will also reap, reflecting the idea of fertility in relation to what is sown in good soil.
James speaks of the fruit of righteousness sown in peace, which can be seen as parallel to bearing fruit in good soil.
